menu.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ART V1 master reference screen for Archeoblocks, one portrait 720x1280 composition (9:16), full bleed without device frame, production target.
Input images: image 1 is the actual current menu, preserve its centered panel / emblem / title / subtitle / four stacked buttons hierarchy and generous spacing. Image 2 is the existing artifact pack, use the circular sandstone seal as material and silhouette inspiration only.
Primary request: Create ONE polished main menu for a warm handcrafted archaeological casual puzzle, unified direction "Sunlit Sandstone Courtyard". Hand-painted stylized soft 3D relief, clean premium casual, not photorealistic.
Scene/backdrop: quiet ancient excavation courtyard in warm daylight, pale sandstone arch and large worn blocks framing the sides, distant courtyard softened, very sparse olive foliage at far edges, cool muted shaded corners. Large central light sandstone/parchment panel with calm flat interior, rounded lightly chipped corners, shallow carved edging; no dense ornaments.
Composition at logical 720x1280: safe content x56..664 y120..1160. Emblem in x250..470 y250..410: simple round archaeological sandstone seal, bronze spiral center. Game title at y480..540, subtitle y570..610. Primary large green mineral button x98..622 y656..742, then three secondary pale sandstone buttons x98..622 y760..830, y850..920, y940..1010. Four buttons total. Maintain centered layout like reference, not an adventure landscape poster.
Text verbatim Cyrillic: title "Археоблоки"; subtitle "Раскапывай находки, собирая линии"; buttons top to bottom "Играть", "Экспедиции", "Коллекция", "Настройки". Readable clean type, dark umber on light panels, ivory on green primary, bold friendly title with restrained carved character. No extra text or currency.
Palette: parchment #E8D7B3, sandstone #C7AC7A, dark text #332A21, shadow #39352D, primary jade #346A53. Gold #C8973F ONLY tiny emblem accent; no golden button borders. Lighting upper-left, modest lower-right shadows; soft mineral bevel, no sharp white specular flares.
Constraints: these are reference-screen labels, future labels stay live text; do not imitate baked bitmap text assets. Each panel and button must be individually separable later; background not entangled with controls. No sparkles, no HDR, no glowing treasures, no casino style, no photorealism, no busy microtexture. Main Play button unmistakably primary, other three quiet secondary. One coherent screen, no annotations.

gameplay.initial_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one master GAMEPLAY reference screen, portrait 9:16 full bleed, logical 720x1280, Archeoblocks ART V1.
Inputs: IMAGE 1 actual runtime screenshot after 9 LEGAL moves of Chapter III expedition 5, authoritative exact board layout, UI order, piece shapes and counts. IMAGE 2 approved ART V1 menu: match its sandstone carving, gentle mineral bevels, warm upper-left light, typography, restrained foliage and premium handcrafted rendering. IMAGE 3 Core Blocks Pack v1: material/silhouette reference, tone down overly bright amber and white highlights.
Create a production-feasible reskin of Image 1, preserving exact grid and all occupied cell locations. Keep the board flat orthographic and the visual focal point. No extra cells, no perspective. 8 COLUMNS x 8 ROWS EXACTLY, equal square cells, generous thin dark dividers. Board outer square approximately x70..650 y315..895 in logical720x1280, playable grid about x108..612 y351..855. Maintain the source UI structure; do not enlarge header to squeeze board.
Backdrop quiet sandstone, softened olive corners, no literal vista behind cells. One chunky ancient sandstone board frame with subtle chips only at exterior. Quiet dark recessed cells with greatly reduced per-cell rim brightness (no golden checkerboard outlines). Colored blocks smooth polished minerals with restrained upper-left bevel: orange-amber NOT yellow-gold, jade green, lapis blue, muted purple, clay red. Frame less contrasty than playable blocks.
EXACT BOARD MAP: rows top-to-bottom, columns left-to-right. E = empty excavated recessed dark earth. A=raised amber-orange block. G=raised jade green block. B=blue block. P=purple block. R=red block. S2=reinforced dark cool-grey stone with TWO short light durability strokes. S1=dark cool-grey stone with ONE short stroke. T=dark olive-brown ROOT knot with 2-3 thick tendrils and visible holes, contained inside cell. D2=flat dark brown soil depth2 with subtle cracks.
row1: A E S2 E E S2 E E
row2: A S1 E E E G E G
row3: A T T T T G G G
row4: A A T T E E D2 E
row5: E E E B B B B E
row6: G E S2 P G S2 E E
row7: E E P P P E E E
row8: G R R P E E E E
Markers EXACTLY three: row2 col2 on top of stone; row4 col7 on soil; row7 col4 on purple block. Each tiny gold diamond in dark ring, fine gold cell perimeter, visible above material. Not artifact faces or whole objects. Soil depth1 is under row2col2 stone; do not expose it by moving the stone. Soil depth2 under row7col4 block; do not remove block.
Hint preview EXACTLY four E cells at rows7-8 cols6-7: translucent RED mineral square2x2 ghosts (30% opacity so recessed earth visible), cream dashed outline per cell, unmistakably a future placement. The hint does NOT occupy these cells. No checkmarks on hint. Root-growth-warning only row2col3: a fine muted olive outline with small directional tendril; it is NOT a gold target.
HEADER: pause button left pale sandstone with text "Пауза". Right aligned title over 2 lines "Заросшие катакомбы 5 —" / "Заросший проход"; beneath it "Фрагменты: 0 / 3". Compact readable dark umber type on pale quiet stone.
Objective centered verbatim "Откройте три части амулета".
Secondary text verbatim "Иногда безопаснее перекрыть предупреждённую клетку, чем сразу рубить корень." split into 2 readable lines. Keep breathing space.
Below board title "Фигуры", then three equal sandstone slots in one row. Slot1 label "Квадрат 2×2" and four red blocks in 2x2. Slot2 label "Линия 3 — вертикаль" and THREE green blocks in one vertical line. Slot3 label "Большая Г" and FIVE amber-orange blocks, FOUR vertically, one to right of lowest cell. Same cell unit size across slots. Slot1 selected by fine CREAM outline, NOT gold; matches red hint on board.
Two secondary sandstone action buttons below slots: "Отменить · 1" and "Подсказка". No DEBUG, infinity, ads, currency, invented reward availability counters. Footer "Ходы: 9" left, "Счёт: 290" right. Text large enough at mobile scale, friendly clean Cyrillic sans. No text except specified.
Keep all data exactly. One coherent real playable mid-game frame, not arranged decorative polyomino art. Material family from menu, no overlaid art-review annotations. No casino gems, no sparkles, no large golden board frame, no noisy microtexture, no moss covering edges of cells, no invented mechanics. Reference-screen text represents future live UI nodes, never a production text bitmap.
gameplay.refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the provided Archeoblocks gameplay master reference.
Make a single controlled readability refinement, preserving EVERYTHING about the game state, 8x8 grid, all element positions, Russian texts, three gold markers, header, frame, palette family, UI order, numbers and four dashed hint cells. Same portrait proportions. Do not add or remove cells or blocks.
1. Replace the SIX circular root-knot icons ONLY at row3 columns2,3,4,5 and row4 columns3,4 with natural stylized dark olive-brown interwoven ROOTS: 2 or 3 broad irregular woody branching tendrils with exposed earth gaps, no circular disk center, NO face-like holes or eyes, not round medallions. Clear diagonal organic silhouettes, low sheen, contained inside existing cells.
2. Tone down the five AMBER blocks on board (column1 rows1,2,3,4 and row4col2) and the five amber blocks in slot3 to copper-orange polished mineral (#C58035) with a restrained cream bevel. No bright yellow/gold or white sparkle. Preserve raised square shapes and the exact big-L form (4 vertically plus 1 at bottom right).
3. Make every elementary block in ALL THREE bottom piece slots the SAME visible width and height: about 30px square in this reference. Red slot1: four tiles square2x2. Green slot2: three tiles vertical. Orange slot3: five tiles bigL, four vertical + one bottom right. Center each complete shape within its own existing slot. Keep the labels and slot borders fixed.
4. Quiet the repeating rims around EMPTY excavated cells: darker matte earth lips, reduce highlight contrast roughly one-third, preserve a readable dark inset profile and the exact grid. Keep the three artifact target outlines gold and unchanged. Leave soil depth2 at row4col7 flat.
All text exact as reference. No invented assets, no extra components. Hint four cells remain transparent red and dashed ivory with excavated terrain showing through. Same upper-left light and soft carved sandstone finish.

notes: One menu, one gameplay, one controlled gameplay refinement. Initial gameplay draft is not a deliverable.
